scope: R4: first real-Hyprland validation of the native desktop provider frontend, in a disposable nested Hyprland

bugFound.description: PLUGIN_INIT compared __hyprland_api_get_hash() and __hyprland_api_get_client_hash() as const char* pointers, so the module always threw "headers/runtime mismatch" and could never load. Fixed by comparing std::string contents (as breezebars does). No earlier test loaded the real module into Hyprland.

method: check-desktops-hyprland.py starts Hyprland 0.56.2 (same patched binary as the session) as a client window sent silently to session workspace 9, loads the module only there, sets count 4, enables it, opens two own kitty windows (workspace 1 and 2) and runs test-desktops-hyprland (original KDE VirtualDesktopInfo, TaskFilterProxyModel, BwmTaskSource fed by the real native-tasks.py snapshot, NativeDesktopControl barrier). Then SIGTERM to the nested process group and the temporary session rule is retired.
verified: arbitration active, 4 desktops, current 1 in a real Hyprland
KDE requestActivate applied by the Hyprland dispatcher (activeworkspace)
Hyprland-side workspace change reflected in KDE currentDesktop
original current-desktop filter shows only the window of the active workspace and follows activation
paused connection ignores requests; resume restores them
module never loaded into the session compositor; focus/workspace unchanged; no leftover instance
notVerified: loading the module at login in the user session (requires make install, startup hook and re-login)
full auxiliary preview with --native-desktops (nested monitor has no description for --output)
multi-output/per-screen activation in a real compositor
long-running stability, logout teardown in the session
